def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    def dom(line):
        c=Counter(line); k,c2=c.most_common(1)[0]; return k,c2/len(line)
    Lr=[(r,dom(g[r])) for r in range(H) if dom(g[r])[1]>=0.7]
    Lc=[(c,dom([g[r][c] for r in range(H)])) for c in range(W) if dom([g[r][c] for r in range(H)])[1]>=0.7]
    rare={v:n for v,n in cnt.items() if n<80}
    marked_r={r for r,d in Lr if any(g[r][c]==v and v in rare for c in range(W))}
    marked_c={c for c,d in Lc if any(g[r][c]==v and v in rare for r in range(H))}
    # fallback: dominant color of unmarked lattice lines (rows and cols)
    rowcols=[(r,dom(g[r])) for r in (r for r,_ in Lr) if r not in marked_r]
    rowcols+=[(c,dom([g[r][c] for r in range(H)])) for c in (c for c,_ in Lc) if c not in marked_c]
    from collections import Counter as C2
    fbc=C2(d[0] for d in [d for _,d in rowcols]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    mr,mc=sorted(marked_r),sorted(marked_c)
    for i in range(len(mr)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(mc)-1):
            cs=[g[mr[i]+a][mc[j]+b] for a in (0,1) for b in (0,1)]
            s=set(cs)
            row.append(cs[0] if len(s)==1 else fbc)
        out.append(row)
    return out

for n in (1,2,3):
    p=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); e=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n,p==e, p, e)
print('TEST:',json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def runs(line,minlen):
    best=cur=0; prev=None
    for v in line:
        cur=(prev==v)+cur if prev is not None else 1
        prev=v; best=max(best,cur)
    return best>=minlen

def solve(g,minlen=3):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    fill=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]          # fill color = MOST frequent
    L=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]            # line color = 2nd most frequent
    def dom(line): return Counter(line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    lr=[r for r in range(H) if runs(g[r],minlen) and dom(g[r])==L]
    lc=[c for c in range(W) if runs([g[r][c] for r in range(H)],minlen) and dom([g[r][c] for r in range(H)])==L]
    marks=set()
    for r in lr: marks|=set(g[r][c] for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (fill,L))
    for c in lc: marks|=set(g[r][c] for r in range(H) if g[r][c] not in (fill,L))
    mr=[r for r in lr if any(g[r][c] in marks for c in range(W))]
    mc=[c for c in lc if any(g[r][c] in marks for r in range(H))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(mr)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(mc)-1):
            cs={g[mr[i]+a][mc[j]+b] for a in (0,1) for b in (0,1)}
            v=next(iter(cs)) if len(cs)==1 else None
            row.append(v if v is not None else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    # p: lattice color = color of some uniform (all-one) row
    unif={v:{r for r in range(H) if all(x==v for x in g[r])} for v in set(v for r in g for v in r)}
    cand=[v for v,rs in unif.items() if rs]
    p=max(cand,key=lambda v:len(unif[v]))           # lattice color
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    fill=cnt.most_common(2)[1][0]                  # block fill
    marked_cells={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c] not in (p,fill)}
    def dom(line,v=None): return Counter(line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    HR=[r for r in range(H) if dom(g[r])==p]
    LR=[r for r in HR if any((r,c) in marked_cells for c in range(W))]
    # VC: arithmetic progression from marked columns, within grid
    mc_cands={c for r,c in marked_cells}
    # step = min gap; extend minimally then extend to grid edges while keeping spacing
    sortedc=sorted(mc_cands)
    step=min(sortedc[i+1]-sortedc[i] for i in range(len(sortedc)-1)) if len(sortedc)>1 else 1
    # choose start: the smallest marked col consistent (use min)
    VC=[c for c in range(sortedc[0],sortedc[0]+step*(W//step)+1,step) if any((r,c) in marked_cells for r in range(H))]
    if not VC: VC=[sortedc[0]]
    MR=LR[:]
    base_out=[]
    for i in range(len(MR)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(VC)-1):
            cs={g[a][b] for a,b in ((MR[i],VC[j]),(MR[i],VC[j+1]),(MR[i+1],VC[j]),(MR[i+1],VC[j+1]))}
            row.append(next(iter(cs)) if len(cs)==1 and next(iter(cs)) not in (p,fill) else fill)
        base_out.append(row)
    # homes per color
    homes=Counter()
    for i in range(len(MR)-1):
        for j in range(len(VC)-1):
            v=base_out[i][j]
            if v not in (p,fill): homes[(v,(i,j))]+=1
    for i in range(len(MR)-1):
        for j in range(len(VC)-1):
            v=base_out[i][j]
            if v in (p,fill): continue
            reg=(i,j)
            if homes.get(v,{})>=2: continue     # color used in multiple base regions -> no spill
            # spill down
            r=i+1
            while r<len(MR)-1:
                r+=1
                if r>=len(MR)-1: break
                next_row=MR[r]
                marks_r={g[next_row][c] for c in range(W) if g[next_row][c] not in (p,fill)}
                if marks_r-iset:=marks_r and any(q!=v for q in marks_r): break
                for jj in range(len(VC)-1):
                    base_out[r][jj]=v
                r+=1
                if r>=len(MR)-1: break
    return base_out

for n in (1,2,3):
    p=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); e=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n,'match',p==e,p,e)
print('TEST:',json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

# Fix: rare = minority colors; marked lines = those containing rare. Lines are rows/cols dominated by a single non-rare color.
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    p=f=c.most_common(2)[1][0]  # line color
    fill=c.most_common(3)[2][0] if len(c)>2 else f
    rare={v for v in set(c)-{p,fill}}
    def dom(line): return Counter(line).most_common(1)[0][0]
    hr=[r for r in range(H) if any(g[r][cc] in rare for cc in range(W))]
    vc=[cc for cc in range(W) if any(g[rr][cc] in rare for rr in range(H))]
    out=[]
    for i in range(len(hr)-1):
        row=[]
        for j in range(len(vc)-1):
            cs={g[a][b] for a,b in ((hr[i],vc[j]),(hr[i],vc[j+1]),(hr[i+1],vc[j]),(hr[i+1],vc[j+1]))}
            v=next(iter(cs)) if len(cs)==1 and v not in (p,fill) else fill
            row.append(v)
        out.append(row)
    return out
for n in (1,2,3):
    pred=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n,'match',pred==exp,pred)
